additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373841-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R4 170001708] Cable Management issue CRM:00797001163
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
This is a known issue. There is a gap between the cable and clamp, and rubber adhesive tape needs to be wound according to the table below. Since the rubber adhesive tape cannot be ordered separately, we advise ordering a set of cable clamps.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0373841 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason

Yes

Yes

Yes
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "

" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "

".
Thank you.
